subject: Replenishment request: convert vacated SDE3 seat to SDE4 via internal transfer
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2026-09-30 09:12 -0700
Subject: Replenishment request: convert vacated SDE3 seat to SDE4 via internal transfer

Team —

Quick background: we had an SDE3 (IC3) on my team leave for personal reasons last week (headcount freed). I’m proposing we convert that open slot into an IC4 role and backfill via an internal transfer from Infra: Rohan Mehta has expressed interest in moving to product infra -> app platform work and would be a straight move.

Why this helps:
- Immediate continuity: Rohan is 6+ months into cross-team pairing, low onboarding risk.
- Business impact: the new scope requires senior ownership on reliability and multi-tenant performance; an IC4 fits better.
- Cost profile: releveling raises comp roughly to the SDE4 band, but we save on external hiring time/cost.

Requesting approvals for:
1) Reclassify the vacated SDE3 headcount to an SDE4 (comp band uplift)
2) Approve an internal transfer for Rohan into my team (start target: 2026-10-18)
3) Confirm we can absorb the comp delta against Q4 hiring reserve or define chargebacks

Attached: headcount_impact_q4.xlsx (simple delta sheet) and proposed_relevel_compband.pdf (band justification + suggested comp max). See the doc link for a short mutual action plan.

Next steps I suggest: Neha — can you advise on comp-band signoff flow? Jonas — can finance confirm which charge codes to use? Laura — if we need JD tweaks or posting, can your team own internal announcement?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: headcount_impact_q4.xlsx (spreadsheet), proposed_relevel_compband.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Replenishment request: convert vacated SDE3 seat to SDE4 via internal transfer

Thanks Vanessa — this looks sensible and I’m aligned in principle. A few notes from People Ops perspective:

1) Compensation: releveling from IC3 -> IC4 requires a band signoff from People + Compensation Council. The attached PDF suffices for an initial review, but comp council needs the proposed target OTE and any sign-on/relocation (if applicable). Please fill the 2-line comp proposal in the PDF (base / eq target).

2) Internal transfer policy: we can fast-track internal moves when tickets are low and manager approvals exist. I’ll need written confirmation from Rohan and his current manager (cc’d below in a follow-up) that they’re supportive of the move date. Also require Rohan to fill a one-page transfer form and his latest performance summary.

3) Timeline & approvals: if we want to close by Oct 18, comp council needs to meet by Oct 7 for an exception (relevels at this cadence are handled weekly during hiring season). I’ll put this on the docket if you confirm numbers by EOD Oct 4.

Action items for Vanessa:
- Complete the comp lines in proposed_relevel_compband.pdf
- Get Rohan and his manager to reply-all confirming intent/availability

I’ll start the comp council thread once I have the numbers.

—Neha
Neha Kapoor
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

I reviewed the headcount delta in headcount_impact_q4.xlsx. High-level finance take:

- Annualized comp delta for converting IC3 -> IC4 (median) is ~ $18k (base + benefits).
- If we start the internal transfer 10/18 and count hiring impact in Q4, the pro-rated delta for 2026 is ~$6.5k.

We can cover the incremental cost against the Q4 hiring reserve (cost center 4300-HIR) if Vanessa confirms there are no other large increments planned for the team this quarter. Otherwise we’ll need a chargeback to the product org (code 2210-PROD).

Practical asks: please confirm the final proposed OTE (base + eq estimate) and whether there’s any lump-sum sign-on or retention we need to model. I uploaded a short worksheet to the shared link to capture the final numbers.

If Neha needs an expedited comp council approval, finance will mark this as "operational critical" to keep the review to 48 hours.

—Jonas
